name: Genu Valgum in Children
definition: Knock-knee alignment in children, often physiologic during development but pathological when excessive, asymmetric or persistent beyond expected age.

typical: Medial knees approximate with ankle separation

investigations.principle: Standing long-leg radiographs are used for persistent/pathological deformity.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury, deformity or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent significant deformity may require guided growth or corrective osteotomy.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-vikriti phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Knock-knee alignment in children, often physiologic during development but pathological when excessive, asymmetric or persistent beyond expected age.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
